events.title: Cologne 3-Day Tour with Phantasialand Option
events.description: Nestled on the western fringes of the country, Cologne is one of the best cities in Germany to explore. Famed for its cathedral, Kölsch beer and love of carnival, this sociable city by the Rhine makes for a vibrant city break. The beautiful Gothic cathedral, which towers above the Old Town was artfully reconstructed after its devastation in World War II. Today, it’s a place of quaint cobbles and historic breweries, along with some outstanding art museums. events.description: At Christmas time, Edinburgh transforms into a truly magical city, full of twinkling lights, festive food and music. Nestled in the heart of the historic city centre, enjoy the traditional German-style Christmas Market with over 70 stalls unique gifts and tasty treats. Wander through the fun fair, enjoy the views from Scotland’s largest ferris wheel or enjoy some ice skating. £139 per person Includes: Luxury coach travel, free time to explore Edinburgh’s Christmas Festival

Get a bird’s eye view from the Ferris Wheel or take a spin on the merry-go-round as the sweet, spicy scent of waffles and Glühwein drifts through the chilly air. events.title: Aachen Christmas Market
events.description: Aachen Christmas Market transforms the historic old town around the Cathedral and Town Hall into a festive village. events.title: Brugge Christmas Market
events.description: This well-preserved medieval city, with its beautiful setting, is host to one of Belgium’s most famous Christmas Markets, offering an abundance of winter treats, warm Glühwein and tasty snacks. Brugge’s two Christmas Markets in the city centre are guaranteed to be beautifully decorated with their warm finish and atmospheric lighting in the typical Winter Glow style. These blissful winter hamlets with their cosy ambiance, packed with knick-knacks are sure to get you into the Christmas spirit. £119 per person Includes: Luxury coach travel, return ferry crossing, free time in Brugge

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. Use the official newcomers page for RAF Alconbury reporting instructions.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Office before arrival for on-base waitlists and off-base referrals. Temporary lodging is available through the base lodging office where offered.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival and assist with base orientation. Contact your gaining unit if no sponsor is assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource, Military.com, and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
